operators.officialTariffModelEvidence: EMOBITALY states that the owner of each individual charging point defines the charging-service price; components may include initial, energy and time tariffs. Therefore EMO cannot safely be priced network-wide or by power class alone.

tariffEvidence.result: Eight additional EMO EVSE have explicit station/EVSE-to-price mappings. They are rankable individually only.
tariffEvidence.decision: Keep EMOBITALY partial/station-level. Do not extrapolate Roma prices to other EMO stations or infer price from connector power.

negativePaths: A network-wide EMOBITALY tariff remains invalid: official EMOBITALY documentation says each charging-point owner defines the tariff.
Power-class inference remains invalid: existing EMO anchors already show different AC prices and activation fees between sites.
operators.blockingCondition: Remaining EMO EVSE require a current station-specific PUN/my.emobitaly/app record or equivalent deterministic first-party mapping.
